question: The Begums of Bhopal founded a primary school for girls in the early twentieth century at ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aligarh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Bhopal province was ruled by four women Kudsia Begum, Sikander Begum, Shah Jahan Begum and Sultan Jahan Begum in the 19th century.**
 
• In the 20th century, the begums of Bhopal founded a primary school for girls in Alighar. Hence option 3 is correct.
 
• **Begum Rokeya and Sakhawat Hossain founded the schools for Muslim girls in Patna and Calcutta respectively.**
 
• In 1877, Kudsia Begum was decorated with the Order of the Imperial Cross.
 
• In 1881, she died and left the personal property of her granddaughter Shah Jahan Begum.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• After the Revolt in 1857 had been suppressed, this loyalty was rewarded in the Queen’s Proclamation of 1858 in which Sikandar was granted the title of Nawab to Nawab Sikandar Begum to rule over Bhopal.
 
• After the death of Kudsia Begum's husband, she declared her 15-month-old daughter Sikandar Begum as the rightful heir.
 
• **Kudsia Begum approached a British agent to legitimize her status and garnered support from religious authorities to combat the widely held belief by Muslims that women could not rule.**
